statements.english: Some recent interdisciplinary research has come out with results that at first sight seem contradictory—a city needs to have a sense of activity, so it needs to be lively, with sounds like the clack of high heels on a pavement or the hiss of a coffee machine, but these mustn't be too intrusive, because at the same time we need to be able to relax.

statements.english: To make matters worse for the government, it soon emerged that the Princess's trip had been approved by the Foreign Office, and that she was in fact very well-informed about both the situation in Angola and the British government's policy regarding landmines.

segments.text: To make matters worse for the government

words.meaning: （不定式符号，无实义，不表目的）

segments.explanation: to make matters worse 是固定的独立不定式短语，作插入语（评注性状语），意为“更糟糕的是”，对全句情况进行评注，不表示目的。内部结构：make + matters（宾语）+ worse（宾语补足语）+ for the government（介词短语，表对象“对政府而言”）。

statements.english: In response to the same forces that have driven the world economy, universities have become more self-consciously global: seeking students from around the world who represent the entire range of cultures and values, sending their own students abroad to prepare them for global careers, offering courses of study that address the challenges of an interconnected world and collaborative research programs to advance science for the benefit of all humanity.

statements.english: To classify parenting as a personal choice for which there is no collective responsibility is not merely to ignore the social benefits of good parenting; really, it is to steal those benefits because they accrue to the whole of society as today's children become tomorrow's productive citizenry.
statements.chinese: 把父母抚养孩子界定为不需社会整体负责的个人选择不单是忽略了良好的教养会给社会带来的效益，事实上，这是窃取了那些利益，因为今天的孩子会成为未来不断繁衍生息的社会公民，对于整个社会来说，这种利益是不断积累的。

segments.explanation: 名词短语作主语，其中 of...serves 为介词短语修饰 story。
介词短语作谓语动词 serves 的补语，表示“作为……”。
引导同位语从句，解释说明 illustration 的内容。

tree.en: The old story of...serves as a good illustration that
tree.zh: 那个……的老故事可以很好地证明……

children.zh: 那个……的老故事可以很好地

statements.english: Every coin has two sides, so...
statements.chinese: 每件事情都既有优点也有缺点，……也是如此。

segments.explanation: 名词短语作主语，指代每一枚硬币（比喻每件事）。
及物动词作谓语，表示拥有。
名词短语作宾语，表示两面。
并列连词，表示因果关系，连接后续分句。

tree.en: Every coin has two sides so
tree.zh: 每件事情都既有优点也有缺点，……也是如此。

children.zh: 每件事情都既有优点也有缺点

statements.english: To improve the situation, it is advisable for you to take the following measures:...
statements.chinese: 为了改善情况，明智之举就是采取以下措施：……

segments.explanation: 不定式短语作目的状语，修饰主句。
形式主语，指代后面的不定式短语。
系动词，构成主系表结构。
形容词作表语，说明主语的性质。

segments.text: for you to take the following measures
segments.explanation: 不定式短语作真正主语，for you 为逻辑主语部分。

tree.en: To improve the situation it is advisable for you to take the following measures
tree.zh: 为了改善情况，明智之举就是采取以下措施：……

statements.english: In short, great efforts should be made to...
statements.chinese: 简而言之，我们必须努力……

segments.explanation: 介词短语作状语，表示总结或概括。
名词短语作主语，其中 great 为定语。
情态动词加被动语态构成谓语。
不定式符号，引导目的状语（此处句子未完，to 后接动词原形）。

tree.en: In short great efforts should be made to
tree.zh: 简而言之，我们必须努力……

statements.english: I shall feel obliged if you will favor me with a call at your earliest convenience.
statements.chinese: 如您方便，请早日来电，我将不胜感激。

segments.explanation: 主句的主语，指代说话人。
主句的谓语部分，表示将来会感到有义务或感激。

segments.text: if you will favor me with a call at your earliest convenience
segments.explanation: 由if引导的条件状语从句，说明主句成立的条件。

tree.zh: 如您方便，请早日来电，我将不胜感激。
